card.name: Mixing and reconstitution step boundaries
card.fires_on: Punctuation, step markers and spaces right after an instruction to add liquid, measure, or shake in a preparation procedure. It marks the point between one step and the next.

modes.label: Sentence end after adding liquid
modes.description: The period after a step that adds a measured volume of liquid to a container.
modes.example: Add 60 mL of water to the bottle<<.>> Replace the cap and shake the bottle vigorously

modes.label: Step markers
modes.description: A step number or letter bracket that begins the next preparation step.
modes.example: Step <<4>> Remove the top layer of the diluent

modes.label: Space after shake duration cue
modes.description: The space after 'for' in a shaking instruction, just before the number of seconds.
modes.example: Shake vigorously for<< >>5 to 10 seconds immediately after

card.writes: It suppresses words about mixing and butterflies, so it seems to hold back repeated mix-related words after a preparation step.
card.plain: It fires at the break between steps in directions for mixing or reconstituting a liquid medicine.
